title: The derived tensor unit is compact on a qcqs scheme
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme]. There is an object U in D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] isomorphic in D(O_X) to the unit of the fixed derived tensor structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and U is compact [def-pc-compact-object]. Coproducts are those of [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums].

source.place: Proposition perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (Tag 09M1), proof, first paragraph; structure-sheaf case

proof.text: Construct O_X[0] using the single functor. Its degree-zero homology is O_X, and all other homology sheaves are zero. The structure sheaf and the zero free sheaf are quasi-coherent. The fixed derived tensor unit is definitionally O_X[0], so this constructs U in the full quasi-coherent subcategory with Iso.refl as its ambient unit identification.

source.place: Proposition perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (Tag 09M1), proof, first paragraph; structure-sheaf case

proof.text: Use [lem-pc-derived-ambient-has-coproducts] and [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-closed-coproducts] to see that the inclusion of the quasi-coherent full subcategory preserves coproducts. Apply [lem-pc-derived-global-sections-cohomology-coproduct] to the ambient cofan formed from its coprojections.

source.place: Proposition perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (Tag 09M1), proof, first paragraph; structure-sheaf case

proof.text: Apply the natural additive equivalences [lem-pc-derived-structure-sheaf-hom-hypercohomology] to each summand and the coproduct. Lift ambient maps to the full subcategory and apply DirectSum.map to the component equivalences. This map is bijective by componentwise injectivity and surjectivity. Naturality identifies the conjugate of the canonical compactness map with the bijective global-sections comparison. DirectSum.addHom_ext checks this equality on every summand. Cancel the target equivalence to obtain injectivity and surjectivity of the canonical Hom map of [def-pc-compact-object], and assemble the existence statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_compact_derivedTensorUnit (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] :
    letI : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) := derivedQCohDirectSums X
    ∃ U : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      Nonempty (U.obj ≅ 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X)) ∧ IsCompactObject U
